characters.description: The innkeeper of the Wandering Inn outside Liscor, where Goblins and members of several species can find protection and meet on uncertain common ground. Her hospitality repeatedly draws her into the city's disputes and makes the inn more than an ordinary business.
characters.name: Erin

characters.description: The inn's practical manager and Mrsha's guardian. She organizes its staff, household, and daily security while building a life apart from the royal identity she once knew. Her sense of order complements Erin's more instinctive way of handling guests and crises.
characters.name: Lionette

characters.description: A young white-furred Gnoll who lives at the Wandering Inn under Erin and Lionette's care. She is part of the household they are trying to protect while floods, dungeon activity, and hostility toward the inn make ordinary life increasingly difficult.
characters.name: Mrsha

characters.description: An individual Antinium who leads Painted Soldiers and newly individual Workers. He is trying to give both groups purpose beyond their assigned duties, and to find voluntary activities that can unite Antinium whose training and daily responsibilities are very different.
characters.name: Pawn

characters.description: One of Pawn's Antinium sergeants, responsible for chess and other activities among the individual Workers. He communicates largely through gestures and helps guide a group that is only beginning to develop preferences, friendships, and recreation of its own.
characters.name: Purple Smile

characters.description: A Painted Antinium sergeant who helps train the soldiers under Pawn’s command.
characters.name: Yellow Splatters

characters.description: A senior Liscor guardsman and the Free Antinium's revelantor, balancing his obligations to the city with the needs of his Hive. His authority crosses the uneasy boundary between Liscor and the Antinium beneath it, especially when dungeon access becomes contested.
characters.name: Klbkch

characters.description: An independent Antinium Hunter employed at Erin's inn as a guard and bird hunter. He earns wages, owns personal belongings, and follows interests that differ sharply from the obedience expected by the Hive. Erin's protection allows that individuality to continue.
characters.name: Bird

characters.description: The ruler of Liscor's Free Antinium, directing thousands through a mental network while testing whether genuine individuals can strengthen her Hive. She and Klbkch have pursued Antinium individuality for years, but she still measures each new person against the Hive's survival.
characters.name: Free Queen

characters.description: The blind ruler of River Farm and Durene's partner. He is building an engineering-centered realm called the Unseen Empire.
characters.name: Laken Godart

characters.description: Laken's witch and general, entrusted with covert military work as danger approaches the Unseen Empire. She leaves River Farm with part of its forces for a concealed operation, supported by message magic and an urgently prepared alchemical weapon.
characters.name: Wiscaria

characters.description: Magnolia Reinhart's spy, formerly known to Wiscaria as Oddveig. She approaches Laken Godart with Magnolia's offer of recognition, support, and peace in exchange for temporarily withholding his trebuchets and their construction secrets.
characters.name: Sacra

characters.description: Chieftain of the Flooded Waters tribe, commanding a mixed Goblin force that includes Redfang riders.
characters.name: Rags

characters.description: Rags's experienced Hobgoblin second-in-command and a seasoned organizer within the Flooded Waters tribe.
characters.name: Pyrite

characters.description: A leader among the Redfang riders serving the Flooded Waters tribe. He accepts Rags's command while his warriors still remember their former chieftain, Garen Redfang. His loyalty gives Rags authority over an elite force with its own history and identity.
characters.name: Red Scar

characters.description: A noblewoman held with her travelling party by the Flooded Waters tribe after earlier fighting against Goblins. She recognizes that Rags is willing to take prisoners and negotiate, and offers ransom, protection, and safe passage in return for the people the tribe holds.
characters.name: Lady Bethel

characters.description: An independent Redfang chieftain who joins Tremborag in rejecting the Goblin Lord's demand that their tribes submit to him. He sees the Goblin Lord's reliance on a human master as another form of enslavement and is prepared to resist a much larger army.
characters.name: Garen Redfang

characters.description: The immense leader of the Mountain City Goblins, defending his stronghold alongside Garen Redfang against the Goblin Lord. His mountain fortress has prepared passages and choke points, and his own body can transform into a more powerful fighting form.
characters.name: Tremborag

characters.description: An undead-backed Goblin war leader whose army is blamed for Zel Shivertail's death and remains a major threat. He commands disciplined Goblins and undead in a campaign that is drawing the attention of Liscor, northern armies, and rival Goblin chieftains.
characters.name: Rhys

characters.description: The missing former captain of the Horns of Hammerad, described as a one-armed Minotaur who may still be somewhere inside Liscor's dungeon. Erin offers a substantial reward for truthful information, while his former teammates prepare to confront the place where he vanished.
characters.name: Calruz

characters.description: A half-elf adventurer who leads the present Horns of Hammerad.
characters.name: Ceria

characters.description: The Horns of Hammerad's necromancer, willing to use undead as practical scouts and fighters despite the distrust his magic attracts.
characters.name: Pisces

characters.description: A fighter and member of the Horns of Hammerad.
characters.name: Yvlon Byres

characters.description: The Antinium adventurer on Ceria's Horns of Hammerad team.
characters.name: Ksmvr

characters.description: A Redfang Hobgoblin who once came to kill Erin but now lives at her inn, guards it, and wants to protect his companions.
characters.name: Head Scratcher

characters.description: One of the Redfang Hobgoblins sheltered by Erin. He is quietly teaching himself to play guitar in the inn's basement while also serving among its defenders.
characters.name: Numbtongue

characters.description: A Redfang Hobgoblin archer living at the inn as one of Erin's protected guests.
characters.name: Bad Arrow

characters.description: A Redfang Hobgoblin fighter and one of Erin's protected guests at the inn.
characters.name: Rabbit Eater

characters.description: A sword fighter among the five Redfang Hobgoblins living under Erin's protection.
characters.name: Shorthilt

characters.description: An influential Drake Wall Lord in Liscor who is grieving Zel Shivertail.
characters.name: Ilvriss

characters.description: Liscor's Watch Captain, responsible for the city's security.
characters.name: Zevara

characters.description: A Liscor strategist and officer in the city Watch.
characters.name: Olesm

characters.description: A human from Earth studying magic at an academy where powerful factions guard, monitor, and exploit his knowledge. His real name is withheld because names can be used in hostile magic. Although his magical progress is rapid, protection also makes him a controlled political asset.
characters.name: Black Mage

characters.description: A Revivalist mage who brokers information. After tracking Black Mage to a hidden academy complex, she connects him with her faction.
characters.name: Montressa

characters.description: A half-troll Paladin, Laken Godart's consort, and a defender of River Farm.
characters.name: Durene

characters.description: Leader of an all-female Goblin warrior unit in the Flooded Waters tribe. She wants her force to become effective without depending on the male-dominated Redfang riders.
characters.name: Poison Bite

characters.description: Lionette's ashfire bee, able to ignite herself in flight even though the effort leaves her exhausted.
characters.name: Apista

characters.description: A captive Cave Goblin allowed to live under the watch of the Redfang Hobgoblins.
characters.name: Pebblesnatch
